# Main Street

> Main Street is a Los Angeles experiential marketing and customer acquisition agency. We turn audience attention into measurable growth through experiential marketing, face-to-face customer acquisition and real-time market intelligence.

## Services
- [Experiential Marketing](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/services/experiential-marketing): Experiential marketing in Los Angeles: immersive brand experiences, pop-ups and activations that build lasting emotional connections.
- [Customer Acquisition](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/services/customer-acquisition): Face-to-face customer acquisition in Los Angeles: trained field teams that turn conversations into loyal customers.
- [Market Intelligence](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/services/market-intelligence): Market intelligence from the ground: real-time consumer feedback and field data that sharpen your strategy.
- [Brand Activations](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/services/brand-activations): Brand activations in Los Angeles: high-impact pop-ups, street teams and flagship moments built to convert.
- [Territory Expansion](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/services/territory-expansion): Territory expansion for brands: turnkey field deployment into new cities with trained local teams.

## Case studies
- [Telecom Customer Acquisition](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/projects/telecom-customer-acquisition): See how Main Street used face-to-face field marketing to win telecom customers in busy Los Angeles-style city corridors.
- [Solar Adoption Campaign](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/projects/solar-adoption-campaign): A community outreach campaign that connected homeowners with clean energy through friendly, face-to-face conversations.
- [Retail & Venue Activation](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/projects/retail-venue-activation): A flagship retail pop-up activation that turned shoppers into customers and advocates.
- [Multi-Market Brand Expansion](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/projects/multi-market-brand-expansion): How a coordinated field team launched one brand across multiple cities with consistent quality.
- [FinTech Onboarding Activations](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/projects/fintech-onboarding-activations): Experiential pop-ups that guided new fintech users through sign-up with trust and clarity.

- [Inside a High-Converting Brand Activation](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/blog/inside-a-high-converting-brand-activation): A look inside a high-converting brand activation: audience research, a reason to stop, a trained team and measurement.
- [How to Scale Customer Acquisition Without Losing Your Brand](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/blog/scale-customer-acquisition-without-losing-your-brand): How to scale face-to-face customer acquisition across cities while keeping every interaction consistent with your brand.
- [Ground Data: How Live Consumer Feedback Sharpens Your Strategy](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/blog/how-live-consumer-feedback-sharpens-strategy): How live consumer feedback gathered on the ground sharpens your marketing strategy in real time.
- [Why Brand Ambassadors Drive Customer Retention](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/blog/why-brand-ambassadors-drive-customer-retention): Why trained brand ambassadors improve customer retention, and how to measure the results that last.
- [How to Choose an Experiential Marketing Agency in Los Angeles](https://mainstreet.landingprofile.com/blog/how-to-choose-an-experiential-marketing-agency-in-los-angeles): A practical guide to choosing an experiential marketing agency in Los Angeles: local knowledge, training, measurement and fit.
